content.short: Stripe Crypto Onramp provides an embeddable, customizable solution for instantly buying crypto.
content.description: Stripe Crypto Onramp provides a fast, simple way for crypto businesses—DEXs, NFT marketplaces, wallets, and dApps—to offer crypto purchases to their users. Leading Web3 companies like MyEtherWallet, Magic Eden, Audius, and Argent rely on Stripe Crypto Onramp to deliver a seamless experience with optimized conversion and instant settlement. Developers can integrate the onramp in roughly 10 lines of code, abstracting away the complexity of coordinating KYC, payments, fraud prevention, and compliance services.
content.meta: Stripe Crypto Onramp lets consumers quickly buy crypto via a customizable onramp. Discover Stripe Crypto Onramp and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
